annotations.title: US county disaster deadlines lookup (assistance cutoff, IRS postponement)

description: Use this when you need to know, for a US county, whether a federal disaster is declared, until when survivors can apply for FEMA individual assistance, and to what date the IRS postponed tax deadlines. For 1 to 25 county FIPS codes: declarations of the last 18 months, application deadline, IRS postponement with release URL, statutory mandatory extension (120 or 60 days, with reason), days left in the county time zone. No personal data. Not affiliated with FEMA or the IRS. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

fips.description: 1 to 25 county FIPS codes (2-digit state + 3-digit county), comma-separated

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.

name: disasters_lookup

data.description: OpenFEMA citation, IRS releases read date, time zone source

disclaimer.description: OpenFEMA statement; not legal or tax advice; not affiliated

licence.description: Licence of the source data: nom, url, source, attribution (required statement)

results.description: One entry per county: fips, county, state, as_of, time_zone, time_zone_split_county, declarations[]: declaration, type, title, incident_type, declared_on, incident_begin, incident_end, designated_area, individual_assistance, assistance_deadline, assistance_open, assistance_days_left, irs {status, postponed_to, days_left, release_url, release_id, other_releases, automatic_relief (when the county is listed in an IRS release: the IRS applies the relief automatically to taxpayers located in the covered area, others call the IRS; null otherwise)}, mandatory_extension_end (date or null), mandatory_extension_days (120, 60 or null), mandatory_extension_reason (plain-English reason, also when null), latest_postponement_end, fema_url

rules.description: Rules applied, with official URL and status; the statute in force (26 U.S.C. 7508A as amended in 2021 and 2025) is listed with what it changes, and the superseded regulation is marked as such

title: US county disaster deadlines lookup (assistance cutoff, IRS postponement)
